Home.manifestoTitle: Permettere all'utente di esprimersi nella forma più naturale possibile: la parola.

portability.title: Yours to take away

comments.membersSub: Default. Published right away, you can hide them later.

PlatformSettings.title: Platform settings
PlatformSettings.subtitle: Super admin only · every change is written to the audit register
PlatformSettings.thresholdNote: Above: blurred + queued. Fail-open if the service is down.
PlatformSettings.auditRetentionNote: Older events are deleted from the database (archived to storage first, if enabled). Minimum 7 days.
PlatformSettings.footerNote: Shown at the bottom of every public page, on the platform and on every blog. Free Markdown: images and links are supported.
PlatformSettings.footerColumn3Hint: Always platform-set: a blog cannot override it (unlike columns 1 and 2).
PlatformSettings.footerBottomBarHint: Always and only platform-set, no blog can override it.
PlatformSettings.infraNote: Read-only here: values come from NOCT_* environment.
PlatformSettings.defaultLocaleNote: Used for visitors and new accounts; each user can override it in their profile.
PlatformSettings.superAdminOnly: Only the Super Admin can change platform settings.
PlatformSettings.deploymentNote: Set in the environment (NOCT_DEPLOYMENT_MODE): "solo" hides user management.
PlatformSettings.registrationNote: "Invite" and "Closed" block new sign-ups with different messages; invitations are not managed by the platform yet.
PlatformSettings.ssoNote: Only providers configured in the environment can be selected; no selection = all configured ones.

Auth.loginIntro: Sign in with your email. The username is never used to sign in.
Auth.otpEmail: Enter the 6-digit code we sent you by email.
Auth.otpApp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
Auth.registerIntro: A space of your own to write, in your language. The username can be changed at any time.
Auth.registrationClosed: Registrations are closed on this platform.
Auth.registrationInvite: Registration by invitation only: ask whoever runs the platform.

Auth.resetPasswordIntro: Enter the code you received by email and your new password.
Auth.resetSuccess: Password updated. You can now sign in with the new password.

Profile.downloadDataSub: Profile, owned blogs, posts and comments written, saved fragments, follows and API tokens.
Profile.deleteAccountSub: Sessions, API tokens, social links, fragments and SSO removed for good. Blogs, posts and comments already written remain, authored by "Deleted user". Not reversible.
Profile.gdprNote: Data is processed in the EU under the GDPR. The location used for the theme's sunrise/sunset is computed on your device and never sent to us.
Profile.fallbackLanguagesHint: (also to translate your content into — max {max})
Profile.emailStepOldHint: A code was sent to your current email ({email}). Enter it to continue.

Your username still always works as a fallback identifier, visible and editable in the settings above.
Profile.domainInstructions: Add this TXT record to your domain's DNS, then press "Verify":
